notes: One typescript contents sheet, with typed page number - 541 - and pencilled archive sheet number 85. It contains 25 numbered entries: 3.8–3.10, 4.1–4.6, 5.1–5.5 and 6.1–6.11, plus the headings for sections 4, 5 and 6. No date, salutation, signature or authorial question/doubt mark is present. H provides a description only and is unavailable for textual collation; every h_reading is null and every diff_h is false. The five explicit C doubts were all inspected and remain unresolved. Six local typewritten overtypes are preserved; the two Jacobson underprints and the j in Détermination were confirmed directly in half b. The small low point at the section 4 separator is reproduced as a shape of uncertain material and punctuation status. A separate short low trace beneath the crowded 6.10 correction is also reproduced with uncertain assignment. The thin pale vertical seam across the upper leaders and the horizontal sheet crease were seen as surface features, not assigned authorial ink. The three source images were each actually viewed once, in the required order, followed by five retained crop images each once. No OCR, external research, other page, other reader, delegation or TeX engine was used.
